title: Turbine
text: Turbine for boosted engines, 5 inputs, 4 outputs; {Turbine type} selects turbine type, {Include wastegate} selects, {Calibrate Performance Maps} sets the calibrate tables with measured data, {Corrected mass flow rate table, mdot_corrfx_tbl} sets the lookup table array, {Efficiency table, eta_turbfx_tb} sets the lookup table array, {Corrected speed breakpoints, w_corrfx_bpts1} sets the fixed geometry, {Pressure ratio breakpoints, Pr_fx_bpts2} sets the fixed geometry, {Corrected mass flow rate table, mdot_corrvr_tbl} sets the lookup table array, {Efficiency table, eta_turbvr_tbl} sets the lookup table array, {Corrected speed breakpoints, w_corrvr_bpts2} sets the variable geometry, {Pressure ratio breakpoints, Pr_vr_bpts2} sets the variable geometry, {Rack breakpoints, L_rack_bpts3} sets the variable geometry, {Reference temperature, T_ref} sets the temperature, {Reference pressure, P_ref} sets the pressure, {Wastegate flow area, A_wgopen} sets the area, {Pressure ratio linearize limit, Plim_wg} sets the area, m^2, {Ideal gas constant, R} sets the constant and {Specific heat at constant pressure, cp}. Values come from the instance.
